label: Idealist
terms_note: Non-profit jobs; apply via employer link.

endpoints.call: keep — assist; the Open Network API (Idealist Listings API + Idealist Apply API, 'Volunteer Match, powered by Idealist') is a paid partner product for CSR / government / community platforms focused on
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Terms of Service §(j): no access 'by means of any automated program, expert system, electronic agent or bot … (including … spiders, robots, scrapers, crawlers, avatars, data mining tools, or the like)'; §(k) no scraping / republishing. The Open Network API requires an inquiry and pricing ('Open Network API Pricing'); documentation links (Listings API, Apply API) are gated behind the partner inquiry.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Idealist Listings API key; 'API keys are issued manually. Contact support@idealist.org to request a production key.' Sent as the Basic-auth username with an empty password.

adapter.terms: Idealist Listings API documentation (https://api-sandbox.idealist.org/listings-api): 'Access to the Listings API is granted on request'; 'All usage of the Idealist API must abide by our Terms of Service' (https://www.idealist.org/en/terms-of-service); listings shown on a partner platform 'must carry attribution to Idealist using one of the approved logos' (https://www.idealist.org/en/design). Responsible use: 'Send requests sequentially, not in parallel', 'Wait at least 250ms between requests', and store the most recent since value to fetch incrementally.

me.note: No account endpoint; the key is verified with a jobs listing request for changes since now ('401 Unauthorized - check your API key').

search.note: Incremental feed, not a keyword search: GET /api/v1/listings/jobs 'returns up to 100 jobs, ordered by oldest updated first' and pages with since = the last job's updated value ('since is inclusive, meaning that you should expect to get the last job again'). query, location and page are not sent; pass next_cursor back as cursor to continue (it is set when a full page of 100 came back), and read details with get_posting. hasMore and updated are in raw.

get_posting.note: Job details: description (rich text HTML), org, address, applyUrl / applyEmail / applyText, salaryMinimum / salaryMaximum (decimal strings, in raw), salaryPeriod, locationType, expires. '404 Not Found - It can mean a job has expired, has been hidden, etc.'

not_offered.apply: The Apply API only creates applications for volunteer listings ('create listing applications for volunteer listings', POST https://www.idealist.org/api/v1/listings/volops/{volop_id}/apply, https://api-sandbox.idealist.org/apply-api); jobs are applied to through the job's applyUrl / applyEmail.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging endpoint; the Listings API covers jobs, internships and volunteer listings only.
